name: EtherDelta
rootCause: EtherDelta's DNS records were compromised in December 2017. Attackers redirected users to a phishing frontend, obtaining their keys and stealing both ETH and tokens. Estimated losses reached $1.4 million, but no contract bug was involved. The root cause was a DNS hijacking of EtherDelta's website, allowing attackers to serve a fraudulent frontend to users and capture their wallet credentials.
